originalPath.description: Path in that commit when it differs from the current path (whole-file rename).

originalStartLine.description: First line of this block in the commit that last changed it.

startLine.description: First line in the file at `commit`, 1-based.

commits.description: Commits first referenced in this chunk.

oneOf.description: P4-09. Declared in `CoreReady` only once the daemon implements the workspace reads.
P4-10: tree listing, file content, file history and per-file changes at a commit.
P4-11: `fullFile` on diff requests returns the whole file as context.
P5-01: user-triggered operations that write to the repository or use the network. Fetch first.

remotes.description: The remotes that were fetched, in Git's order.

text.description: The first `lines` lines when `kind` is text; at most 1 MiB.

totalLines.description: Total line count of the blob when known, also when `text` was truncated.

patch.description: At most 128 KiB for a normal diff; up to 1 MiB when the whole file was requested (P4-11).

files.description: Files changed under the path; 1 for a file.

status.description: Relative to the first parent (or the empty tree for a root commit).

oneOf.description: Unmerged index, sparse checkout or incomplete preflight; no operation is attempted.

size.description: Blob size in bytes; null for directories and submodules.

patch.description: At most 128 KiB for a normal diff; up to 1 MiB when the whole file was requested (P4-11).

originalPath.description: Source path when Git reports a rename or copy.

complete.description: False when more paths changed than `max_entries`; `total_paths` is then a lower bound.

draftCommitMessage.description: Draft commit message from MERGE_MSG / SQUASH_MSG / COMMIT_EDITMSG when distinct from HEAD.

headReference.description: HEAD when the status was read; it may differ from the HEAD the session opened with.
